description: Mirror an rc_sequence into user_workflows so the customer can edit / run / schedule it from the onork-app /dashboard/automations surface. Produces a node/edge graph compatible with the existing flow-step mapper. Returns the user_workflows row id (uuid). The customer's user_id is required (onork-app Supabase auth user); we look it up from the account's owner_email when not passed.

location_id.description: CRM location id — when set, the engine routes emails through CRM

user_id.description: onork-app Supabase auth user id. If omitted, looked up by dr_accounts.owner_email.

name: rc_sequence_to_user_workflow
